paragraphs.text: The Western Wastes are a desert in south-western Jamuraa on Dominaria , west of the River Toloron and east of the Great Wall .

A few miles west from the River Toloron , the terrain reverts to broken shale, crumbled arroyos of orange sand, and scanty bush. The wastes are an expanse of pebbly hills and crooked draws with little vegetation and no water. There is no iron nor gems, no animals. Few enter the wastes since the nomads shun the area, considering it unlucky and believing, correctly, that unscalable cliffs block the way west.
